text:
Noah_CS: Starting onboarding thread for Aurora Health Ops. Quick intros: Noah (CS lead), Harper (AE), Sam (SE), Ana (customer ops).
OnboardBot: Kickoff scheduled 2026-08-03 14:00 CT.
Ana_Stakeholder: Goals: triage assistant to route cases faster and provide concise summaries. Compliance: HIPAA-adjacent, logs must be accessible for audit but PII must be tokenized.
Sam_SE: We'll enable tokenization and per-tenant encryption. Need to confirm audit log retention policy (Ana). Also will require a secure SFTP for data ingest.
Harper_AE: Finance green-lit pilot budget. Timeline ask: initial pilot (5 care coordinators) live by Aug 20.
Noah_CS: Success metrics: 5 coordinators actively using for 21 days, 30% faster triage time, zero PII leakage incidents, positive post-session rating avg >= 4.
Ana_Stakeholder: We'll provide data sample and security contact today.
Sam_SE: Technical checklist:
- Provision private EU node with audit logging
- SFTP setup and tokenization pipeline
- Deploy summarization model and routing policy
- Dashboard for triage time and post-session ratings
Noah_CS: 30/60 timeline:
30d: infra + security review complete, ingest pipeline validated, 5 coordinators onboarded
60d: larger rollout planning & exec readout
Harper_AE: Renewal discussion flagged if 30d adoption misses target.
Noah_CS: Owners: Noah = CS project lead; Sam = technical lead; Harper = commercial owner; Ana = customer sponsor.
Ana_Stakeholder: Feedback capture: we'd like weekly digest with anonymized examples and a short survey.
Sam_SE: We'll auto-generate weekly digest and ensure redaction on examples.
OnboardBot: Recurring standup Thursdays 09:00 CT created.
Noah_CS: Immediate next steps: Ana to share contact + data sample; Sam to provide ETA for provisioning; Harper to schedule rep invites.
Ana_Stakeholder: Sending details now.
Sam_SE: ETA: 3 business days after we get credentials.
Noah_CS: I'll update the board and post progress here. Ping me for any blockers.
